title: vacuum reads the TidStore struct its own reset destroyed
live_proof: inspection at the 17.0 pin plus the upstream commit: dead_items_reset (src/backend/access/heap/vacuumlazy.c:2905) takes the parallel branch at :2909-2913 and RETURNS without refreshing vacrel->dead_items, so the caller keeps the destroyed store. Upstream 3549ffb6af (2025-10-03, 'Fix reuse-after-free hazard in dead_items_reset') adds exactly that refresh before the return; it postdates the 17.0 release of 2024-09-26, so the pre-fix shape is present at the pin.
lifetime_ender: parallel_vacuum_reset_dead_items destroys and recreates the store, and dead_items_reset returns without updating vacrel->dead_items
shape: stale pointer to a recreated object
